youtube-transcript.description: YouTube transcript API for AI agents. Extract transcript, captions and subtitles from any YouTube video URL with timestamps, language selection, manual/auto caption preference, optional translation, and JSON, plain text or SRT output. Built for RAG ingestion, LLM context, research, summarization, knowledge-base indexing and autonomous agent workflows. No API key or signup required. Payment settles on-chain only after a successful response.

url.description: YouTube video URL (youtube.com, youtu.be, shorts, embed, live)

videoId.description: 11-character YouTube video ID alternative to url

language.description: Preferred transcript language code (e.g. en, es, pt, fr)

sourcePreference.description: Caption source: any (default), manual (human-created), or generated (auto-generated)

translateTo.description: Target language code for YouTube caption translation

includeSegments.description: Include timestamped segments array in output

format.description: Output format: json (default), plain text, or SRT subtitle format

formatted.description: Formatted output (text or SRT depending on format)

youtube-captions.description: YouTube captions and subtitles extractor for AI agents. Get clean captions, subtitles or transcript from any YouTube video URL with timestamps, language selection and JSON, plain text or SRT output. Optimized for workflows where the agent specifically needs captions or subtitles. Payment settles on-chain only after a successful response.

url.description: YouTube video URL (youtube.com, youtu.be, shorts, embed, live)

videoId.description: 11-character YouTube video ID alternative to url

language.description: Preferred captions language code (e.g. en, es, pt, fr)

includeSegments.description: Include timestamped caption segments array in output

format.description: Output format: json (default), plain text, or SRT subtitle format

formatted.description: Formatted output (text or SRT depending on format)

segments.description: Timestamped caption segments (when includeSegments=true or format=srt)

youtube-video-to-text.description: YouTube video-to-text API for AI agents. Convert any YouTube video URL into clean transcript text with JSON, plain text or SRT-ready output. Designed for agents performing video-to-text conversion, content extraction, RAG pipeline ingestion, research indexing and automated summarization. Payment settles on-chain only after a successful response.
